item.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

eFAIR：小时级电力承诺预算下的公平 LLM serving 调度

Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget allocation, and GPU frequency selection through a common normalized-throughput target. Specifically, request dispatching prioritizes requests by desired service level and progress; electricity budget alloca…

item.title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经网络量化误差的 zonotope 抽象解释

Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

生存基准未告诉你的事：模型选择与数据集 regime 的影响

Despite the proliferation of survival analysis methods, current benchmarks often operate under narrow conditions: they heavily rely on the concordance index (C-index) for evaluation and model selection, and frequently either exclude deep learning (DL) methods or underrepresent challenging dataset regimes. To address these limitations, we conduct a large-scale, neutral benchmark comparing 10 classical, tree-based, and DL methods across 49 diverse datasets. Crucially, we treat the model selection criterion (optimizing for C-index, Integrated Brier Score (IBS), or Mean Absolute Error (MAE-PO)) as an independent experimental variable. Using Bayesian mixed-effects modeling, we demonstrate that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions. For complex DL and tree-based architectures, selecting hyperparameters to optimize for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration at a negligible cost to discriminative ranking. Furthermore, method performance (C-index, IBS, MAE-PO, and X-CAL) is fundamentally governed by dataset characteristics. While DL models scale exceptionally well with larger sample sizes, they suffer notable performance dro…

item.title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

方差最优反事实策略设计：样本高效的在线 A/B 测试

Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average t…

item.title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

VAFL：垂直解析联邦学习，闭式解的高效众包服务

Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. Predictive performance and training time identify useful operating…

item.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

将人脑组织分析迁移到语言模型

During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经交流潮流模型的分布外泛化

Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TechReport: Implementing CHERI in gem5
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TechReport：在 gem5 中实现 CHERI 能力安全模型

Despite countless mitigation efforts, memory safety issues still prevail. The recently discovered security issues in PHP underline this fact. One of the most promising approaches to solving this problem is the concept of Capability Hardware Enhanced RISC Instructions (CHERI). There is a well-developed ecosystem of ISA simulators, compilers, operating systems, and hardware designs that support CHERI. However, the lack of a simulator modeling microarchitectural detail hinders efficient and fast design space exploration for CHERI-enhanced designs means the performance impact of CHERI remains understudied. Therefore, we present gem5-CHERI: a CHERI-enhanced adaptation of the gem5 simulator that can boot the CheriBSD operating system and run custom workloads. The simulator is available open-source on GitHub.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TangentPDE：稀疏有限差分监督学习局部算子响应

Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jacobians, and remains applicable to nonlinear solvers without derivative interfaces. Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision…

item.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TabBioMed：大规模生物医学表格学习基准

Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model c…

item.title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

凸/半凸/拟凸函数的结构保持神经逼近

Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and valid…

item.title: Stephen: Verifying Sequencer-Aided Coordination Systems with Cross-View Prophecy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

验证 sequencer 辅助协调系统：跨视图 prophecy 方法验证 SMR/分布式事务

Many distributed systems achieve high performance by relying on dedicated sequencers to order requests, leaving replicas to commit them in that order. Despite more than a decade of such sequencer-aided coordination (SAC) systems, from Corfu and NOPaxos to LazyLog and SwitchBFT, their correctness has been argued only with pen-and-paper proofs or bounded model checking at the protocol level. In this paper, we formally verify implementations of SAC protocols. The sequencer seems to make this easy: it decides the order of all requests, so the proof can place each request's linearization point at the sequencer using a well-known technique, prophecy variables. Yet a linearization point placed at the sequencer is not durable, because the sequencer orders a request before any replica commits it. Crashes and other rare events may trigger a view change that discards the request, nullifying the earlier decision and the proof that rests on it. Our framework, Stephen, extends prophecy variables to handle view changes, and we make three contributions. (1) We develop cross-view prophecy peek, which lets the proof follow a request across view changes until it is either committed or permanently dis…

item.title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中从其他客户端窃取精确训练数据（梯度反演）

Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SoU-RHS：贝叶斯结构化稀疏恢复 CNN 紧凑架构

Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. item.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

更简单的微型递归模型（TRM 变体）

Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. ScaleBench：可扩展可复现的 Kubernetes 自动扩缩容研究实验平台

Autoscaling enables cloud-native applications to meet their SLOs by dynamically adjusting computational resources at runtime. Recent research has explored a broad range of advanced autoscaling approaches, including rule-based, optimisation-based, and machine learning-based techniques, to address the limitations of traditional resource management strategies in cloud-native environments. Despite significant advances, a considerable gap remains between academic innovations and their practical adoption in real-world environments. For instance, Kubernetes deployments commonly rely on the reactive, CPU-based Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, limiting the adoption of more advanced autoscaling approaches. Recent studies have investigated challenges such as autoscaler configuration and reproducible performance evaluation; however, the practical deployment, integration complexity, and operational overhead of research-based autoscalers in Kubernetes environments have received limited attention. To address this gap, we present ScaleBench, a native Kubernetes experimental platform to enable extensible and reproducible evaluation of autoscaling solutions. item.title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中 LoRA 重分配的 rank 预算再思考

Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. RASA also introduces spectral-reference aggregation, which removes the personalized initialization offset while retaining the locally learned increment. Expe…

item.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

长程 RL 专家的 off-policy 巩固：重放而非重采样（替代 MOPD）

Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only a…

item.title: Reliable arithmetic circuits using less reliable (sub-digital) logic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

用更不可靠的亚数字逻辑构造可靠算术电路：推翻超低电压静态失效壁垒

The frequent static failure of CMOS logic gates at ultra-low voltages has historically been perceived as a strict barrier to extreme voltage scaling: this paper introduces a statistical circuit law proving this intuition wrong. We discovered a universal power law connecting gate and circuit static failure probabilities, revealing that circuit failure requires the simultaneous breakdown of an entire gate cluster rather than a single component. Because the required cluster size increases rapidly as voltage drops, low-voltage \textit{sub-digital} logic exhibits surprising inherent resilience to static failure. This insight stems from new theoretical tools we developed to quantify static failure, extending well beyond conventional voltage-margin analysis. Consequently, sub-digital processors could potentially offer a viable, near-term solution to drastically reduce the energy demands of AI.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ReCIM-HD: A 40 nm On-Device Learning Accelerator with Hyperdimensional Computing via Importance-Based Hybrid Digital-ReRAM CIM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧学习（ODL）加速器面临反向传播代价高、类超向量存储/推理能耗大、精度敏感子集易受模拟 CIM 误差影响等问题。

方法 ReCIM-HD 集成无梯度超维计算（HDC）+ ReRAM 模拟 CIM：ReRAM 非易失存储类超向量并做 CIM 相似度搜索，空闲可断电不丢数据；混合数字-模拟 CIM 推理流把精度关键小子集走数字保护；Kronecker HD 编码器降编码开销 + 定制 ISA。

关键数字 40nm 流片，44.17 TOPS/W（混合模式）、75.8 TOPS/W（ReRAM CIM 模式），能效最高比 SOTA 加速器高 20.1×。

为什么值得看 无反向传播的端侧学习 + ReRAM CIM，能效数据亮眼，类脑/HD 计算方向值得跟踪。

item.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 agent 驱动的优化基准多聚焦单软件层（如 kernel），不清楚 agent 能否在生产负载下带来端到端性能提升。

方法 RSIBench-Infra 基准：20 个训练/推理任务、覆盖多模型家族与模态，最多 32 加速器的 NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU 部署；agent 从官方配方的可运行基线出发，可改 engine/kernel/指令层软件栈，OCI 镜像层提交协议保证可复现部署，独立评测端到端性能。

关键数字 全部任务结果中 66.2% 超过 1.10× 已验证加速。

为什么值得看 首个评估 agent 优化生产级训练/推理基础设施的基准，结论务实——agent 能提升，但端到端转化仍难。

item.description:

运动扩散模型对其自身估计的物理探测

Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

预测流程级行为：基准研究（预测式流程监控）

Predictive process monitoring (PPM) typically forecasts the future of individual process instances, hence operating on trace level. Process managers, however, typically operate on process level, e.g., when assigning staff or calculating KPIs. The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions. We answer this question through a comprehensive benchmarking study of two process-level prediction tasks: concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction. Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level. We assess which modeling paradigms are most suitable for predicting process-level behavior and whether existing trace-level PPM can be effectively repurposed for this task. Our results show substantial variation in performance across approaches. Notably, aggregated trace-level predictions cause errors to compound on process-level, reducing a…

item.title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

PGU-Decoder：先验引导的工业路网地图更新统一解码

Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all thr…

PGU-Decoder：先验引导的工业路网地图更新统一解码

Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all thr…

OpenGNS：视觉/语言/扩散模型的梯度噪声尺度开放数据集

The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. Building on this dataset, we study how the GNS depends on hyperparameters, scale, and training progress, and how it relates to the CBS. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘计算任务卸载中，RAN slicing 框架依赖静态计算模型，无法利用现代神经架构带来的动态语义数据表示。

关键数字 相比 SOTA 基线，QoS 违约概率最多降低 1.75，取得更好准确率-违约权衡。

item.title: Neural Memory Orchestration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 HPC 工作负载越来越卡在内存层次而非计算，mmap 文件/swap/分层内存的缺页占墙钟时间越来越大；内核启发式预取对不规则、数据相关的访问流退化严重。

方法 Overseer 端到端学习式页预取系统：eBPF 采集器观察缺页，transformer 预测器 OverNet 在网附推理硬件上发出未来页地址，内核驻留执行器提前物化页面；OverNet 用 per-instance 序数秩编码增量，单模型即可服务任意目标进程、无需重训。

关键数字 两个缺页重型负载上运行时间约降 35%（Hilbert 曲线遍历）与约一个数量级（稠密矩阵乘法），major-fault 计数相应减少。

为什么值得看 学习式预取首次走到真实硬件部署管线，eBPF+网附推理架构对 HPC 内存瓶颈有直接价值。

item.title: Multilevel Graph Partitioning on GPU Supercomputers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

GPU 超级计算机上的多级图划分算法与实现

Graph partitioning is a key enabler in computational science, with applications to sparse linear algebra, load-balanced parallel computation, and graph computations. In recent years, graphics processing units (GPUs) have become the preferred accelerator on the world's top supercomputers. Despite this, most existing distributed graph partitioners do not utilize GPUs. In this work, we develop a new multi-GPU distributed partitioner based on Jet, a prior single-GPU partitioner. We seek to optimize scalability without sacrificing quality. Our partitioner utilizes CUDA-aware MPI, one-sided communication routines, and an overall bulk-synchronous parallel structure. We demonstrate solution quality comparable to Jet. Our experiments show excellent weak scaling up to 256 GPUs, enabling partitioning of instances significantly larger than a single-GPU partitioner can handle.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

分布式监控中的时序规则挖掘：本地挖掘+全局验证的精确恢复与编译

Specification mining extracts temporal rules that describe relationships between events in recorded system traces. Applying these rules in distributed monitoring systems is more difficult because observations come from different nodes, whose clocks may not be synchronized, and events may be lost or reordered during transmission. In this paper, we study how to aggregate the coverage of mined rules across observers, determine whether their temporal windows are needed during monitoring, and characterize their detection under event loss. Our evaluation uses IPv6 packet traces collected from 21 receivers across four continents. We show that local mining followed by global confirmation recovers centralized rule coverage under suitable conditions while substantially reducing communication overhead. In contrast, merging traces with unaligned clocks can distort coverage by introducing incorrect temporal matches. A window-gain criterion identifies rules that require temporal state, while our loss analysis and broker experiments demonstrate why contiguous losses can be more damaging than independent losses. item.title: MicroAssert: Microarchitecture-Aware Structured Assertion Generation for CPU Verification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

MicroAssert：微架构感知的 CPU 验证断言自动生成

Automatic assertion generation reduces manual verification effort, yet existing approaches struggle to capture microarchitectural behaviors and cross-region interactions in CPUs. We present MicroAssert, a microarchitecture-aware framework that identifies functional regions directly from RTL and generates local and composite assertions through structured contracts and deterministic verification primitives. Coverage-guided feedback further improves verification completeness by progressively expanding proof-relevant RTL coverage. Evaluated on five open-source RISC-V CPUs against three existing assertion generation approaches, MicroAssert achieves 100% syntax correctness and complete branch, statement, and toggle coverage, with an average proven rate of 74.82% and Proof Core coverage of 90.96%. Mutation testing further demonstrates its advantage, achieving an average error detection rate of 28.73%, 1.99 to 3.51 times higher than existing methods. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of microarchitecture-aware assertion generation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 NPU 设计空间探索依赖昂贵模拟器且只回标量反馈（延迟/功耗），无法回答"为什么慢、下一步改哪个架构参数"；prefill 与 decode 还可能受不同资源（算力/HBM 带宽）限制。

方法 CriticNPU 基于在线校准的机理批评者：用显式硬件上限在模拟前过滤弱配置、模拟后聚合算子级运行时为 prefill/decode 瓶颈摘要并预测参数改动效果；配合 Roofline 式模型、工作负载提取器与架构规划器。

关键数字 6 个 LLM 负载×16 部署配置下，74% prefill、87.5% decode 设置达 best-or-tied-best 延迟，模拟调用量约为对比 DSE 基线的一半。

为什么值得看 把"模拟器为什么慢"变成可解释的机理模型，显著省模拟预算，NPU DSE 效率提升直观。

item.title: Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

长上下文 LLM 服务的保留上下文计量与计费框架（三层分离）

Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. The framework provides a bounded per-token accounting rule and measured deployment constraints, rather than a validated utility estimator.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

方法 Lodestone agentic 框架：从执行迹提取热点控制流区打包成可分析单元；agent 描述每个区计算什么、把相同计算合并为家族并循环校验语义；用参考输入输出验证家族；为选定家族提议 ISA 扩展/近核单元/分离加速器，由人类专家决定推进。

关键数字 20 个负载（6 类数据中心工作负载）发现 30 个家族，周期精确模拟+RTL 实现后平均提速 12.6%、最高 80.2%。

为什么值得看 用 agent 语义推理做硬件特化机会发现，比热函数分析覆盖面广，自动化程度高。

Serverless 流处理的局部性感知调度，面向有状态 FaaS 流水线

Stateful Serverless (Function-as-a-Service) environment are increasingly used for stream processing applications. These applications are often structured as pipelines where data flows through a sequence of distinct processing operators. Many operators are stateful and require access to the processing state during execution. To address this, stateful serverless platforms introduce state servers on worker nodes, co-locating state with computation to dramatically reduce access latency. In serverless, these data pipelines are realized by chaining function invocations, passing the processed data from one function to the next. To reduce network overhead, state-of-the-art scheduling approaches employ a distributed worker-level scheduling model, routing locally generated chained requests directly to destination workers, bypassing centralized schedulers. However, these approaches always co-locate state and execution for the same operator in the same worker, which forces most invocations to the next operator to be transferred across workers, thereby increasing both latency and I/O overhead. As a result, this paper proposes LcSched, a novel distributed scheduling strategy tailored for stream …

item.title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧小模型想靠"每晚从白天工作中学"持续改进，但缺乏真实结果时，谁来决定哪些尝试值得学——模型自判和用户反应都可能错。

方法 Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B + LoRA，每晚用 judge 接受的尝试微调，在 WebShop 与 τ²-bench 上跑 127 条"生命"（最长一年）；对比真实结果、用户口头判定、模型自判与一个冻结的"反馈感知"（读用户反应，三个版本）。

关键数字 自判模型先提升后衰减；把礼貌放弃当成功的感知崩了 3/5 条生命；会分辨的感知两周内 4/5 接近 oracle，第 60 天回落到自判水平；97 条生命中失败尝试占比预测学习效果（Spearman ρ=-0.81）。

为什么值得看 对"设备端从反馈自学"做系统长程实验，结论反直觉——反馈质量与结果可见性是生死线。

item.title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

LLM 辅助多保真贝叶斯优化：融合专家知识与数值数据

Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventio…

item.title: LEDGE: An Efficient Simulator for Distributed LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 评估异构边缘设备上分布式 LLM serving 需探索模型切分、设备放置与网络条件，反复做物理实验代价高昂。

方法 LEDGE 轻量模拟器，不执行张量操作：事件图支持非均匀张量/流水线并行，用端到端标定的可复用性能模型估执行成本，并模拟共享链路争用。

关键数字 10 台 Jetson/Raspberry Pi 异构测试床、4 个 LLM 家族 17 种模型-精度组合上，Qwen 部署请求级 MAPE <3.6%，较物理推理聚合加速 135.3×；跨家族零样本延迟 MAPE 7.44%；26,773 次模拟在 83.8 分钟内完成。

为什么值得看 异构边缘 LLM serving 的可复用仿真器，开销低、泛化尚可，做部署策略探索很省事。

item.title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Kernel Ridge Attention：带选择性遗忘的非线性记忆循环序列混合器

Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Agentic Hardware Verification Workflows: A Multi-Strategy Characterization Across Protocol Complexity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Agentic 硬件验证工作流中的推理时扩展：多策略刻画

Inference-time scaling, allocating more compute during generation rather than pre-training, has demonstrated dramatic quality improvements for LLM reasoning tasks. Its behaviour in structured hardware verification code generation, where outputs must satisfy compiler correctness, protocol semantics, and functional coverage constraints simultaneously, is less understood. We present a systematic, simulator-grounded study of inference-time compute scaling for agentic UVM testbench synthesis targeting AMBA protocol bridges. Four inference strategies---zero-shot (\$0.04), raw-feedback iterative (\$0.81), structured inner-loop (\$0.95), and full dual-loop agentic synthesis (\$1.06)---are evaluated across four AMBA targets (Protocol Complexity Index 11.8--22.6) using the Protocol Verification Completeness (PVC) metric, functional coverage, and a six-class UVM error taxonomy (E1--E6). Our central finding is that structured diagnostic feedback acts as an inference-time compute multiplier: the structured inner loop yields roughly $15\times$ more PVC per inference dollar than raw EDA-tool feedback (marginal efficiency, S1$\to$S2 vs. S0$\to$S1). The mechanism is fault targeting, not token reduc…

item.title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

ICICLE：上下文内推理的曲线学习外推（freeze-thaw BO）

Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. Our release samples synthetic training tasks on the fly and provides a freeze-thaw scheduler fo…

item.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 持续学习（CL）移植到真实边缘设备面临两大难题：在线单样本流需实时适应，低 footprint 使传统反向传播训练不可行。

方法 借鉴大脑清醒/睡眠周期，Hypnos 双阶段平台：清醒阶段用低 footprint RISC-V MCU SoC 做高效推理+无梯度原型更新（快速低耗适应）；睡眠阶段由智能充电器执行基于 rehearsal 的梯度更新（长期巩固）。

关键数字 CORe50 NICv2-391 上创边缘 CL 新 SOTA 准确率 78.6%–81.6%，每样本端侧延迟 7.79–10.54 s；比量化 latent replay 少 3.8× 学习步数、22× 学习算力。

为什么值得看 睡眠/清醒双相训练把"白天快速适应、夜间巩固"落成开源平台，能耗/算力瓶颈处理巧妙。

item.title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

把注意力网络变成可解释硬逻辑谓词电路：真值表谓词

We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same twe…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLA 模型动作头推理受内存带宽限制——每步从 DRAM 重读全部权重，却只应用于约五十个 token，延迟与能耗由传输的权重比特数决定。

方法 观察到后续 flow step 会衰减前面步骤的量化误差，提出动作头权重精度随步数递增（2→4 bit）；并设计可编程加速器：DRAM 速率解码熵编码权重的 bit-serial 子阵列，运行时分配器在 linear 层与 attention 间分配，bank 端 requantizer+熵编码器让一份 8-bit 副本替代所有宽度副本。

关键数字 递增宽度比每步 4-bit 少传 25% 比特且保持闭环成功率；RTL 实现跑 GR00T N1.6 动作头单次推理 8.02 ms，比 Thor NVFP4 快 1.7×、能耗低 9.1×。

为什么值得看 把"精度随流步递增"的洞察落到硬件，无校准无训练保成功率，对端侧 VLA 加速很实用。

item.title: HETEROVLM: Edge Multi-Request Vision-Language Model Serving on a Heterogeneous Versal SoC with AI Engines and Programmable Logic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘自动驾驶/机器人需并发服务 deadline 各异的 VLM 请求，GPU 数据中心式 host 调度会让紧急请求久等、小 batch decode 单位 token 能耗高；Versal AIE SoC 既有加速器只映射单模型单输入流、无 decode/请求调度。

方法 HETEROVLM 在异构 Versal SoC 上做多请求 VLM serving：AIE 数组跑 encoder/prefill/attention，可编程逻辑（PL）实现 GEMV 引擎与小 decode 步调度器（按类别和 deadline 排序）；并发请求共享一次读权重的 decode 步，紧急请求在工作单元边界抢占。

关键数字 VC1902 上文本/相机问题首 token 140/303 ms；单请求 decode 比 Tesla T4、Jetson Orin Nano Super 快 1.3×/4.0×，每 token 能耗为其 61%/73%（RTX 3090 Ti 的 51%）。

为什么值得看 边缘多请求 VLM serving 的完整系统方案，AIE+PL 异构分工与抢占调度思路清晰。

自学习生产级边缘栈：可持续 HVAC 控制（数据到阀门）

Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions alone, with a behaviour anchor and critic calibration terms, is scored by four model-free metrics and promoted by atomic hot-swap. item.title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦优化局部更新的代价：更快走向错误答案的偏差分析

Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[μ,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $χ\in[1,L/μ]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-μχ)/(2μL\sqrtχ)$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

混合图神经网络代理：有限元分析的逐元素股骨应力预测

Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. item.title: Dissecting an Unexplored SASS Control-Code Field: Barrier Exemption and Programmable Warp Priority
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 NVIDIA SASS 指令里一个控制码字段在 cuBLAS/cuDNN 等闭源库中出现超 50 万次，但 nvcc 编译用户程序从不发出，其作用一直未知。

方法 首个跨 Volta 到 Blackwell 的系统性研究：指令级微基准揭示该字段控制两个独立硬件机制——屏障豁免（EXEMPT，允许被屏障阻塞的指令提前发出）与可编程 warp 优先级（START/TILE/END 三级）；并实现后编译二进制优化器，不改源码与编译器直接改写二进制。

关键数字 6 张 GPU（4 代架构）上代表性 kernel 提速最高 31.9%；llama.cpp 和 vLLM 生产 kernel 提速最高 5.4%，端到端 LLM 推理提速最高 3.6%。

为什么值得看 挖出 NVIDIA 隐藏硬件机制且可无侵入优化二进制，对 GPU kernel 极致优化很有价值。

item.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

沟通式 on-policy 蒸馏：通过通信蒸馏黑盒教师能力（长程任务）

On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

任务感知融合：多模态材料语言模型的表示选择

Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. item.title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Cap-and-Track：跨漂移容量优化 LLM 推理请求分发

A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. It served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate precursor, though lower-priority work waited longer at backfill peaks. In steady-capacity real-engine replay, Track ran within 1% of the goodput of a fixed rate tuned above measured capacity, with about a quarter of that rate's re…

item.title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

仅通过查询审计黑盒临床预测模型的盲测

Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check agai…

item.title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Atomic MathReasoner：数学 LLM 原子推理技能的实例级组合

Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. It evaluates the preference of each prototype using the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, filters ambiguous assignments through a confidence margin, and distills the resulting pseudo-labels into a lightweight router. During inference, the router selects an appropriate composition prototype for each problem, enabling problem-specific utilization of atomic skills without costly…

item.title: Accelerating Distributed Digital Ising Machines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

分布式数字 Ising 机的加速：面向组合优化与概率采样的规模扩展

Ising machines, dedicated accelerators built around the dynamics of Ising-like spin models, have emerged as a leading platform for combinatorial optimization and probabilistic sampling. The problems that motivate them require millions of spins, far beyond the on-chip capacity of any single device, so a practical Ising machine must distribute its computation across many devices. Prior work reports throughput at a single operating point, leaving the binding resource unidentified and platform crossovers measurable only by experiment; no calibrated cross-platform cost model of distributed Ising machines has been reported, nor have systematic techniques to accelerate their Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) workloads. This work presents a calibrated cost model that decomposes digital Ising sweep time into compute, memory, synchronization, and inter-device communication terms, validated with 4.8% mean error across three GPU generations, FPGA and ASIC up to 1 million spins. Guided by the model, we address each term in turn and propose: (i) a data placement strategy, worth up to 4.2$\times$ speedup; (ii) multi-rate and bounded-staleness schedules that relax the barrier that Gibbs sampling imp…

item.title: A Runtime System for Mitigating Crossbar Port Contention on SM-Partitioned GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SM 分区 GPU 上缓解 crossbar 端口争用的运行时系统

To avoid scheduling delays when running concurrent workloads on a GPU, Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) partitioning mechanisms such as CUDA Green Contexts restrict each workload to separate SMs. Despite this partitioning, concurrent workloads still significantly slow down latency-critical workloads, which recent studies attribute to shared L2 cache and memory contention. However, contention also occurs at the crossbar ports connecting each Graphics Processing Cluster (GPC) of SMs to the L2 cache, as all SMs in a GPC share one port. Green Contexts spread workloads across GPCs, placing concurrent workloads in the same GPCs and forcing latency-critical memory requests to queue behind background requests. Packing workloads into separate GPCs avoids this contention, but forces latency-critical memory requests through fewer ports, limiting memory bandwidth. Consequently, neither spreading nor packing is always faster across workloads and GPUs. Based on these observations, we present GPCPlace, a runtime system that dynamically selects between spreading and packing by profiling workloads on the target GPU to estimate both slowdowns, and hooks kernel launches in the CUDA driver to set SM mask…

However, contention also occurs at the crossbar ports connecting each Graphics Processing Cluster (GPC) of SMs to the L2 cache, as all SMs in a GPC share one port. Green Contexts spread workloads across GPCs, placing concurrent workloads in the same GPCs and forcing latency-critical memory requests to queue behind background requests. Packing workloads into separate GPCs avoids this contention, but forces latency-critical memory requests through fewer ports, limiting memory bandwidth. Consequently, neither spreading nor packing is always faster across workloads and GPUs. Based on these observations, we present GPCPlace, a runtime system that dynamically selects between spreading and packing by profiling workloads on the target GPU to estimate both slowdowns, and hooks kernel launches in the CUDA driver to set SM mask…

item.title: A Fast, Programmable GPU-to-CPU Invocation Layer for GPU-Initiated Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 设备发起通信的主流做法（GPUDirect Async）把传输控制放 GPU 线程，反向 offload 到 host 代理线程被视为慢速回退路径。

方法 KIWI 论证反向 offload 可超越 GDA、应成为一等通信路径，并把它暴露为可编程接口，让用户定义负载特定的通信操作；KIWI-P2P（SHMEM 类库）与 KIWI-EP（MoE 分发/合并内核重构）基于它构建。

关键数字 亚微秒级单程 device-to-host 延迟、每秒数亿次操作；AMD GPU 上专家并行通信延迟最多降 2.3×，vLLM 每 token 输出时间最多降 29%。

为什么值得看 扭转"反向 offload 是次选"的既有认知，可编程接口对 MoE 等负载友好，源码已开源。

item.title: blaris: Windowless Random-Access LZSS for Constrained Microcontrollers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：嵌入式 LZ77 解压器（heatshrink、tamp）需要 RAM 滑动窗口，内存占用与压缩率耦合，且随机访问读延迟高。

方法：blaris 轻量无窗口 LZSS 解压器，面向受限微控制器的 XIP 随机访问：把 token 划分为双向可遍历流并设 2 的幂检查点，直接在压缩载荷内解析反向引用，不分配 RAM 窗口；面向 compress-on-host/decompress-on-device 工作流，假设可信构建期载荷，省略运行时错误与边界检查。

关键数字：压缩率与高窗口 heatshrink/tamp 配置相当；RV32IMC 上仅需 548-784 B Flash、104-112 B 总 RAM；小片随机读比比例匹配的块索引 heatshrink/tamp 快数量级。

为什么值得看：把解压器的内存占用与压缩率解耦，为闪存直接执行场景提供极低资源开销的随机访问解压。

item.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产 LLM 长上下文用稀疏注意力，但 serving 仍须保留完整 KV 历史，GPU HBM 容量限制并发；现有 KV offload 到 host 内存受 PCIe 带宽与 host 容量双重限制。

方法：分析发现即便有 scale-up 内存池，解码吞吐仍被 HBM 容量钳制——热 KV 缓冲与常驻索引器 key 缓存（K-index）占用大量 HBM 且访问模式不同；XM-Sparse 首个基于 scale-up 内存扩展的稀疏注意力 offload 系统：动态 KV 条目用 TMA 检索与注意力做 tile 级流水线融合隐藏延迟，可预测 K-index 访问用 SM 高效 GPU-initiated DMA 预取并避开解码关键路径。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.3 + 模拟 scale-up 内存池：解码吞吐比 PCIe 的 ECHO 高 4.98×、比 HiSparse 高 4.52×，同平台比 naive 集成高 1.34×，覆盖 16K-1M 上下文。

为什么值得看：首个面向 scale-up 内存池的稀疏注意力 offload 系统，按两类缓存的访问模式分别定制 I/O 机制。

item.title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

On-policy 蒸馏目标的理论分析：token 粒度/顺序/速度的选择

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even…

item.title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

LoRA 子空间方向重要性的机制分析：few-shot 幅度原则的 regime 依赖

We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $ρ$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. We test this account with PivotLoRA, which initializes adapters from activation PCA at prediction-relevant positions and applies one output-preserving orthogonal pivot early in training. In few-shot BERT-base classification, PivotLoRA achieves the best average rank among 13 methods and improves over vanilla LoRA in 29 …

item.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

专家构建任务上的 RL 对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 的训练

We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rule…

item.title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

权重空间编程给扩散编辑带来什么

Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing and rewriting the Astra programs then raises CLIP by +6.2 points while joint success changes by -9.7. On a fixed 144-image sample, five additional evaluators give point estimates in the same directions under whole-image target matching; checks of su…

item.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

权重空间编程不需要 Transformer 的实证

Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretra…

item.title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

从运动轨迹读车辆尺寸与动力类型的数据集

Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and li…

item.title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

把 LLM 变成表格分类器（Visa 十亿级微调）

Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. item.title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：核化注意力方法宣称用 O(N) 替代 softmax 的 O(N²)，但五年研究缺乏跨方法、跨规模的系统评估与公平比较。

方法：分效率与质量两半剖析：效率侧对比 FlashAttention 与 SOTA 核化方法（训练与视觉 transformer）；质量侧用统一蒸馏协议评测；提出 LARA++，通过重要性采样 + 自适应提议分布逼近 softmax。

关键数字：FlashAttention 在训练与视觉 transformer 的大多数序列长度上内存更低、墙钟更快（因果 LM 推理内存是唯一明确例外），且核化方法的效率收益常无法在现代基线上复现；统一蒸馏协议下核化方法相对 softmax 有 2-10 分差距，模型规模本身不闭合差距；LARA++ 恢复 softmax 精度最高 99%，但计算开销仍大，效率墙未破。

为什么值得看：核化注意力的系统化"现实核查"，证明差距可闭合但代价未消除，是该方向少见的公允横评。

item.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

检索增强 VLM 的证据权衡基准（20 万条）

Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. item.title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 越来越常以低精度部署，但量化会损害性能；量化如何与采样温度、top-p 等解码设置相互作用？

方法：测量生成熵发现量化平均"加热"模型，且温度对量化模型的影响远大于全精度模型；TempQuant 学习量化模型的温度与 top-p，使其 next-token 概率更接近全精度模型；分两粒度——每请求温度一个全局设置（无需标签即找到接近标签调优的温度），以及逐 token 设置（排名翻转的 token 需加热、排名保持的需冷却）。

关键数字：3-bit Qwen3-4B 上，全局 TempQuant 把 MATH 精度从量化官方推荐配置下的 34% 提升到 51%。

为什么值得看：挑战"量化模型应与全精度模型用相同采样设置"的默认做法，给出无需标签的解码设置校准方法。

item.title: TAILROLL: Tail-Aware Rollout Acceleration for RL-Based LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-17　分类：论文PDF

RL 后训练的尾部感知 rollout 加速，区分失衡与拖尾浪费

RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by rollout: heavy-tailed responses leave engines idle as each step waits for the longest response. Asynchronous training masks, but does not eliminate, idle time. We distinguish imbalance waste (uneven placement and decode contention) from straggler waste (waiting for the longest response). Tail length, not average load, often sets the step bound. We propose TAILROLL, an online scheduler integrated into an open-source RL framework. It combines stateless in-flight migration and sufficiency-gated termination. Migration moves decoding requests between engines at chunk boundaries and resumes them with one re-prefill under a freeness-based, cost-aware tail-balancing policy. Termination stops a response when its GRPO group has enough completed samples for advantage estimation, masking its partial output from the training loss. Across ten configurations, TAILROLL reduces rollout bubble ratio by 21% to 74% and cross-engine KV-cache imbalance by 44% to 79%. In end-to-end RL training, it cuts rollout time by 24% to 34%, full step time by 21% to 22% on long-CoT RL, and p95 request latency by 28% to 37%, while raising generation …
